pose_en: A man lies flat on his back on an exercise mat, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side, his head is at the viewer's left, his feet at the right. Legs straight, left arm relaxed beside his body. His right arm is stretched straight up toward the ceiling, elbow straight, thumb pointing up. His face points straight up and his eyes look at his thumb. One black curved arrow starts at his forehead and points toward the viewer, showing the head rolling to his right.
eind_en: END position: same side view. He still lies on his back with the right arm straight up and thumb up. His head is now rotated about 30 degrees toward the viewer (to his right), so we see more of his face, while his eyes still look up at the thumb.

pose_en: A man lies flat on his back on an exercise mat, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side, his head is at the viewer's left, his feet at the right. Legs straight, left arm beside his body. His right arm is stretched straight up toward the ceiling, elbow straight, thumb up. His face points straight up, eyes on the thumb. One black curved arrow starts at his chin and points toward his chest, showing a nodding movement.
eind_en: END position: same side view. He still lies on his back with the right arm straight up. His chin is now clearly tucked down toward his chest (head nodded about 25 degrees, back of the head still on the mat), while his eyes still look up at the thumb.

pose_en: A man sits upright on a chair, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). Feet flat on the floor, hands resting on his thighs. He wears a headband with a small laser pointer on top of his head pointing forward. About one meter in front of him, at the right edge of the image, is a wall with a sheet of paper at eye level showing a drawn circle. A thin red laser line runs from the headband to the bottom of the circle. One black curved arrow starts at his forehead and points upward, showing the head tilting up slightly.
eind_en: END position: same side view. He sits in the same way, trunk still, but his head is now tilted clearly upward (about 20 degrees), and the red laser line now ends at the top of the circle on the paper.

pose_en: A man sits upright on a chair, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). Feet flat on the floor, left hand on his left thigh. His right arm is stretched straight forward at eye level, elbow straight, fist closed with the thumb pointing up. He looks at his thumb. One black straight arrow starts at the thumb and points back toward his nose.
eind_en: END position: same side view. He sits the same way, but his right elbow is now fully bent and his thumb is held upright about 5 cm in front of the tip of his nose. His head has not moved; his eyes look at the thumb.

naam: Bal van hand naar hand gooien – staand
pose_en: A man stands upright, seen from the front. Feet hip-width apart. Both elbows bent 90 degrees beside his body, palms up, hands about 50 cm apart. A small ball lies in his right hand (at the viewer's left). His head is turned slightly toward the ball and he looks at it. One black arched arrow starts at the ball and curves up to eye level and down to his left hand.
eind_en: END position: same front view. He stands the same way, but the ball now lies in his left hand (at the viewer's right) and his head and eyes are turned toward that hand.

naam: Handen draaien en volgen met je ogen – staand
pose_en: A man stands upright, seen from the front. Feet hip-width apart. Both arms are stretched forward and slightly outward at shoulder height, elbows straight, index fingers pointing up. His head faces forward and his eyes look toward his right hand (at the viewer's left). One black circular arrow starts at his right hand and draws a large circle in the air, going upward first.
eind_en: END position: same front view. His left arm is unchanged. His right arm is now raised so the hand is at the top of the circle, above head height. His head still faces forward while his eyes clearly look up toward the right hand.

naam: Duim volgen met hoofd en ogen samen – staand
pose_en: A man stands upright, seen from the front. Feet hip-width apart, left arm relaxed beside his body. His right arm is stretched straight forward toward the viewer at eye level, elbow straight, thumb up. His head faces straight forward and he looks at his thumb. One black horizontal curved arrow starts at the thumb and points to the viewer's left (toward his right side).
eind_en: END position: same front view. His trunk and feet have not moved. His straight right arm has swung about 45 degrees to his right (viewer's left), and his head is turned the same 45 degrees so his nose still points at the thumb.

naam: Blikstabilisatie horizontaal – zittend op een bal
pose_en: A man sits upright on a large exercise ball, seen from the front. Feet flat on the floor, wider than hip-width, knees bent 90 degrees. Left hand on his left thigh. His right arm is stretched straight forward toward the viewer at eye level, thumb up. His head faces forward, eyes on the thumb. One black horizontal curved arrow starts at his chin and points to the viewer's left (his head turning to his right).
eind_en: END position: same front view. He sits the same way on the ball with the arm still straight forward. His head is now rotated about 30 degrees to his right (viewer's left), while his eyes look sideways back at the thumb in front of him.

naam: Blikstabilisatie verticaal – zittend op een bal
pose_en: A man sits upright on a large exercise ball, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). Feet flat on the floor, knees bent 90 degrees, left hand on his thigh. His right arm is stretched straight forward at eye level, elbow straight, thumb up. His head is level and he looks at his thumb. One black curved arrow starts at his chin and points downward toward his chest.
eind_en: END position: same side view. He sits the same way on the ball, arm still straight forward at eye level. His head is now nodded down about 25 degrees, chin toward the chest, while his eyes look up at the thumb.

pose_en: A man sits upright on a chair, seen from the front. Feet flat on the floor, left hand on his left thigh. His right palm (at the viewer's left) is placed flat against the right side of his head at the temple, just in front of the ear, elbow pointing out to the side at shoulder height. His head faces straight forward and stays still. One black short curved arrow starts at his nose and points to the viewer's left (toward his right hand), showing the turning effort that the hand blocks.
eind_en: END position: same front view. Identical static posture: head straight forward, right palm pressing against the right temple, no visible movement.

pose_en: A man stands upright ready to walk, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). Feet together, arms relaxed beside his body. At the right edge of the image, at eye level, a small round target mark hangs on a wall. His head is level and he looks at the target. One black curved arrow starts at his chin and points downward toward his chest, showing the nodding movement he makes while walking.
eind_en: END position: same side view. He is in mid-step walking toward the target: right leg forward with the heel touching the floor, left leg behind, arms swinging naturally. His head is nodded down about 25 degrees while his eyes look up at the target on the wall.

naam: Voeten samen op balansmat – hoofd draaien
pose_en: A man stands upright on a thick foam balance pad, seen from the front. Feet together touching each other, knees straight, arms relaxed beside his body. His head faces straight forward and his eyes look straight at the viewer. One black horizontal curved arrow starts at his chin and points to the viewer's left (his head turning to his right).
eind_en: END position: same front view. He stands the same way on the balance pad. His head is now rotated about 30 degrees to his right (viewer's left), while his eyes still look straight at the viewer.

naam: Duim volgen in een achtje – zittend
pose_en: A man sits upright on a chair, seen from the front. Feet flat on the floor, left hand on his left thigh. His right arm is stretched straight forward toward the viewer at eye level, elbow straight, thumb up. His head faces forward, eyes on the thumb. One black arrow starts at the thumb and traces a large lying figure of eight (infinity sign) in the air, going first up and to the viewer's left.
eind_en: END position: same front view. He sits the same way and his head still faces straight forward. His straight right arm has moved up and out to his right (viewer's left), the thumb is above shoulder height at the top of the loop, and his eyes look diagonally up toward the thumb.

naam: Eenbeenstand – armen om de beurt heffen
pose_en: A man stands on his left leg, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). His left knee is almost straight. His right leg (nearest to the viewer) is lifted: hip slightly bent, knee bent about 60 degrees, foot about 15 cm above the floor and not touching the other leg. Both arms hang relaxed beside his body. He looks straight ahead. One black curved arrow starts at his right hand and points forward and upward in an arc.
eind_en: END position: same side view. He still stands on his left leg with the right foot off the floor. His right arm is now raised straight up overhead, elbow straight, upper arm beside his ear. His left arm still hangs beside his body and his trunk is upright.

naam: Van zitten naar liggen – op de bedrand
pose_en: A man sits upright on the long edge of a bed, seen from the front (he faces the viewer). Feet flat on the floor, hands resting on the mattress beside his hips. A pillow lies on the bed at the viewer's right (his left side). One black curved arrow starts at his left shoulder and curves sideways and down toward the pillow.
eind_en: END position: same front view. He now lies on his left side along the bed, head on the pillow at the viewer's right, both legs lifted onto the mattress with hips and knees bent about 45 degrees, right hand resting on the mattress in front of his chest.

pose_en: Close-up of the head and shoulders of a man lying on his back with his head on a flat pillow, seen from the front as if the viewer looks straight down at his face (top of the head at the top of the image). His head is perfectly straight and still. His eyes are wide open and both pupils are rolled far up toward his forehead. One black straight vertical arrow starts next to his right eye and points down toward his chin.
eind_en: END position: same close-up front view. His head is in exactly the same position on the pillow. Both pupils are now moved far down toward his chin, exaggerated, with the upper eyelids slightly lowered.

naam: Eenbeenstand – duim volgen met je ogen
pose_en: A man stands on his left leg with his back toward a wall but not touching it, seen from the front. His right knee (at the viewer's left) is bent so that the sole of his right foot is pressed flat against the wall behind him at about knee height. Left arm relaxed beside his body. His right arm is stretched straight forward toward the viewer at eye level, thumb up. His head faces forward and he looks at his thumb. One black horizontal arrow starts at the thumb and points to the viewer's left (toward his right side).
eind_en: END position: same front view. He stands in the same one-leg position with the foot against the wall. His straight right arm has moved about 40 degrees to his right (viewer's left). His head still faces straight forward; only his eyes look sideways toward the thumb.

naam: Voet voor voet lopen – met hoofd knikken
pose_en: A man stands upright on a straight line of tape on the floor, seen exactly from the side: we see his RIGHT side (he faces the viewer's right). His right foot is placed directly in front of his left foot, right heel touching the left toes. Arms slightly away from his body for balance. At the right edge of the image, at eye level, a small round target mark hangs on a wall. His head is level, eyes on the target. One black curved arrow starts at his chin and points downward toward his chest, showing the nodding movement he makes while walking.
eind_en: END position: same side view. He has taken one step along the line: his left foot is now directly in front of his right foot, heel against toes. His head is nodded down about 25 degrees while his eyes look up at the target on the wall.
